page_title: GRA 2-2 BAR | Granada CF v Barcelona 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
90+8' Carlos Neva (Granada CF) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+5' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Oriol Romeu (Barcelona), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
90+4' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Barcelona players look gutted.
90+4' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Cesar Soto Grado wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
90+3' A goal, which was scored by Joao Felix (Barcelona), was disallowed due to offside.
90+1' Although Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) is just on the bench, Cesar Soto Grado has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+1' Paco Lopez is stunned as referee Cesar Soto Grado shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
88' A long pass into the box is latched onto by Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF), who looks up and slams a terrific shot past the keeper but onto the right post. He did everything right but score!
87' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Cesar Soto Grado signals that the goal stands! The Barcelona players celebrate.
86' The Barcelona players halt their celebrations as referee Cesar Soto Grado makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
86' Jesus Vallejo (Granada CF) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Cesar Soto Grado lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
85' 2 - 2 Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) receives a killer pass and scores a great goal after finding the back of the net with a simple finish!
84' Here comes a substitution. Ricard Sanchez is given a rest as he is replaced by Jesus Vallejo (Granada CF).
82' Gavi (Barcelona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
79' Gavi (Barcelona) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Andre Ferreira, who makes a comfortable save.
78' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
77' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) hits a shot towards the left side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Andre Ferreira.
76' Substitution. Lamine Yamal leaves the pitch and is replaced by Oriol Romeu (Barcelona).
76' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Gavi (Barcelona) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner.
76' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Barcelona get a corner.
74' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle after Jose Callejon (Granada CF) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
74' That's the end of the game for Lucas Boye, who is replaced by Jose Callejon (Granada CF).
71' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
70' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Cesar Soto Grado stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
69' A fine pass finds Ferran Torres (Barcelona) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Andre Ferreira reacts superbly to deny him.
68' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) is given a yellow card.
66' A poorly taken free kick by Ferran Torres (Barcelona)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall.
66' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
62' The foul by Lucas Boye (Granada CF) was seen by Cesar Soto Grado who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
61' Here is a change. Fermin Lopez is going off and Xavi gives the last tactical orders to Sergi Roberto (Barcelona).
61' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post.

59' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) wasted a huge opportunity! He received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a decent shot in from close range. Unfortunately for him, it sailed narrowly wide of the right post!
59' The manager makes a subsitution with Raul Torrent (Granada CF) coming on for Alvaro Fernandez.
59' Paco Lopez prepares a substitution. Gonzalo Villar is replaced by Njegos Petrovic (Granada CF).
58' Substitution. Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) replaces Myrto Uzuni.
58' Gavi (Barcelona) trips an opposition player and Cesar Soto Grado signals a foul.
57' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

54' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) won himself some space after the corner kick and tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box. His effort is directed to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes the save.
54' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) steps up to send the ball in.
54' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alejandro Balde (Barcelona). The referee points to the corner flag and Barcelona will take a corner.
52' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) swings it in and Ferran Torres gets on the end of it, but Andre Ferreira shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
51' The resulting corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

51' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Barcelona.
50' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.

48' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Cesar Soto Grado blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
46' Referee Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+7' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) sends it out of play.
45+6' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Granada CF win a corner.
45+1' 2 - 1 Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' Xavi is forced to make a change. Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ronald Araujo.
40' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
39' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
38' The linesman raises his flag. Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) is adjudged offside.

37' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Andre Ferreira shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
36' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
35' Corner kick. Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is ready to send the ball into the box.

35' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. Barcelona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

35' Joao Felix (Barcelona) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Andre Ferreira pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
33' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
28' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes high over the bar.
28' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) works the corner short.
27' The resulting corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) comes to nothing.

27' Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
27' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
26' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Barcelona.
25' Gavi (Barcelona) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
24' Joao Felix (Barcelona) latches onto a decent pass, but flashes his shot just wide of the right post.
22' Joao Felix (Barcelona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
21' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

21' Gavi (Barcelona) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Andre Ferreira pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The referee blows his whistle, Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
19' Granada CF are ruled offside.
18' Joao Felix (Barcelona) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
17' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is about to take a corner kick.

17' Joao Felix (Barcelona) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Andre Ferreira. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

15' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
12' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
11' An attempted cross from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is cleared.
9' Cesar Soto Grado interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Lucas Boye (Granada CF).
6' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
4' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
4' Alvaro Fernandez (Granada CF) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
1' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) was set free in the area by Lucas Boye and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Barcelona will take the kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
